test_cases.summary:
Verify Final level user rejects image
when an image is in IN_REVIEW  state
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Decision – Reject Action
As a final approval user, the user wants to reject images that fail QC checks.

Scenario: Final level user rejects image
Given an image is in IN_REVIEW  state
When the final level user clicks Reject
Then the image should be rejected
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should be rejected
The behavior should be validated when the final level user clicks Reject.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Rejected image moves to previous level
when an image is rejected at the final approval level
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Workflow Rollback – Final Rejection
As a system, rejected images must move back to the previous approval level.

Scenario: Rejected image moves to previous level
Given an image is rejected at the final approval level
When the workflow is updated
Then the image should move back to the previous approval level
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should move back to the previous approval level
The behavior should be validated when the workflow is updated.

test_cases.summary:
Verify REJECTED option available in Select Status
when the user is on the Data Labeling page
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Status Filtering – REJECTED Option
As a user, the user wants to filter rejected images easily.

Scenario: REJECTED option available in Select Status
Given the user is on the Data Labeling page
When the user clicks the Select Status dropdown
Then the REJECTED option should be available
test_cases.acceptance:
The REJECTED option should be available
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Select Status dropdown.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display rejected images under REJECTED status
when the user selects REJECTED from the Select Status dropdown
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Image Listing – Rejected Images
As a user, the user wants to view rejected images separately.

Scenario: Display rejected images under REJECTED status
Given the user selects REJECTED from the Select Status dropdown
When the image grid is displayed
Then the rejected image should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The rejected image should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the image grid is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display REJECTED L indicator
when a rejected image is displayed under REJECTED status
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Rejection Indicator – Level
As a user, the user wants to see rejection level information clearly.

Scenario: Display REJECTED L indicator
Given a rejected image is displayed under REJECTED status
When the image card is viewed
Then REJECTED L should be displayed inside the image
test_cases.acceptance:
REJECTED L should be displayed inside the image
The behavior should be validated when the image card is viewed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Rejected image hidden from IN_REVIEW
when an image is rejected at the final level
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Status Consistency – Rejected Images
As a system, rejected images must not appear in active review lists.

Scenario: Rejected image hidden from IN_REVIEW
Given an image is rejected at the final level
When the user filters images by IN_REVIEW status
Then the rejected image should not be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The rejected image should not be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user filters images by IN_REVIEW status.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Change Select Status to REJECTED
when the user is on the Data Labeling page
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Status Filtering – REJECTED (Rollback)
As a previous level reviewer, the user wants to view rejected images.

Scenario: Change Select Status to REJECTED
Given the user is on the Data Labeling page
When the user selects REJECTED from the Select Status dropdown
Then the status filter should be updated to REJECTED
test_cases.acceptance:
The status filter should be updated to REJECTED
The behavior should be validated when the user selects REJECTED from the Select Status dropdown.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display rejected images after rollback
when Select Status is set to REJECTED
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Image Listing – Rejected (Previous Level)
As a previous level reviewer, the user wants to see rejected images.

Scenario: Display rejected images after rollback
Given Select Status is set to REJECTED
When the image grid is displayed
Then rejected images should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Rejected images should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the image grid is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display REJECTED L indicator
when rejected images are displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Rejection Indicator – Rollback View
As a previous level reviewer, the user wants to see correct rejection level.

Scenario: Display REJECTED L indicator
Given rejected images are displayed
When the image card is viewed
Then REJECTED L  should be displayed inside the image
test_cases.acceptance:
REJECTED L  should be displayed inside the image
The behavior should be validated when the image card is viewed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Enable Accept and Reject actions for rejected image
when a rejected image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Rollback Actions – Previous Level
As a previous level reviewer, the user wants to take action on rejected images.

Scenario: Enable Accept and Reject actions for rejected image
Given a rejected image is selected
When the image action panel is viewed
Then Accept and Reject buttons should be enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
Accept and Reject buttons should be enabled
The behavior should be validated when the image action panel is viewed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Reject moves image to earlier approval level
when a rejected image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Rollback Workflow – Reject Action
As a previous level reviewer, the user wants to further reject the image.

Scenario: Reject moves image to earlier approval level
Given a rejected image is selected
When the user clicks Reject
Then the image should move to the earlier approval level
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should move to the earlier approval level
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Reject.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Accept moves image to final approval level
when a rejected image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Rollback Workflow – Accept Action
As a previous level reviewer, the user wants to forward the image again.

Scenario: Accept moves image to final approval level
Given a rejected image is selected
When the user clicks Accept
Then the image should move to the final approval level
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should move to the final approval level
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Accept.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Move image out of Levels after acceptance
when an image is accepted by a Levels user
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Workflow Progression
As a system, accepted images must move forward in the workflow.

Scenario: Move image out of Levels after acceptance
Given an image is accepted by a Levels user
When the image status is updated
Then the image should move to the next approval level or final stage
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should move to the next approval level or final stage
The behavior should be validated when the image status is updated.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Multiple users access same image
when multiple users are configured under Approval Level
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Access – Multiple Reviewers
As a QC system, multiple reviewers must be able to view the same images.

Scenario: Multiple users access same image
Given multiple users are configured under Approval Level
When each user accesses the same session
Then the same IN_REVIEW  images should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
The same IN_REVIEW  images should be visible
The behavior should be validated when each user accesses the same session.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image moves to next approval level after acceptance at non-final level
when an image is in IN_REVIEW status at a non-final approval level (e.g., Level 1 or Level 2)
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image workflow progression after non-final approval

Scenario: Image moves to next approval level after acceptance at non-final level

Given an image is in IN_REVIEW status at a non-final approval level (e.g., Level 1 or Level 2)
And the user belongs to the current active approval level
When the user clicks Accept on the image
Then the image should move to the next approval level in the workflow
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should move to the next approval level in the workflow
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Accept on the image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image becomes editable at the new active level after workflow transition
when the image has moved to the next approval level after acceptance
test_cases.description:
Feature: Edit access at new active approval level

Scenario: Image becomes editable at the new active level after workflow transition

Given the image has moved to the next approval level after acceptance
When a user from the new active approval level opens the image
Then the image should be accessible and editable, with all editing tools enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should be accessible and editable, with all editing tools enabled
The behavior should be validated when a user from the new active approval level opens the image.
